title: GameData skill-book index load rejection
scope: scripts/game_data.gd and detached fixture test only

findings.before: _build_skill_book_index() returned void; validation failures only returned from the helper and _build_item_catalog/_build_indexes continued as success.
findings.after: The validator returns bool and stable load_error codes; _build_item_catalog propagates false and _build_indexes clears the partial catalog/index maps and returns false.

findings.before: A direct load_database() failure after a successful load left _initial_load_complete true because only ensure_loaded() reset it.
findings.after: load_database() clears _initial_load_complete before any reload work; a failed direct reload is no longer advertised through is_loaded().

coverage: component catalog READY via ContentLayers.ensure_loaded and GameData.ensure_loaded
unknown target sanitized by runtime importer through _build_indexes
direct usable unknown target relation rejection
direct reload loaded-state reset and signal suppression

constraints: No formal data, registry, item, or skill authority files changed.

Detached fixtures duplicate component-READY runtime catalog; the direct reload check temporarily toggles only in-memory loaded flags and restores them before the formal reload. Full world/portal/UI READY is outside this component test and remains covered by separate B01 evidence.
PC headless component native55 direct and native54 related PASS; complete world/UI and Android/device NOT_RUN.
open_boundary: Mode/expansion callers still ignore the bool return from load_database(); caller-level user-facing failure handling is outside this minimal state-ownership repair.
